chant: ॥ Shri Gaurishankar Baikunthnath Dham • Sacred Vedic Acharyas & Priests ॥
title: Sacred Priests & Vedic Acharyas
subtitle: Meet the learned Acharyas, Mukhya Pujaris, and Vedic scholars who perform daily Nitya Aarti, Rudrabhishek, and sacred rituals at Baikunthnath Dham

priests.name: Acharya Pt. Rameshwar Jha Shastri
priests.title: Mukhya Pujari (Head Priest)
priests.specialization: Rudrabhishek, Shri Sahasranama Archana, Rajbhog Aarti
priests.bio: Devoted scholar of Shukla Yajurveda, dedicated to performing sacred daily nitya aartis and Mahaganga Jalabhishek for over three decades at the Hari-Hara Dham.

priests.name: Pt. Vidyanand Pandey Vedacharya
priests.title: Senior Vedic Scholar & Hawan Acharya
priests.specialization: Maha Mrityunjaya Jaap, Purnahuti Hawan, Vastu Shanti
priests.bio: Expert in Samaveda & Rigveda mantras, leading 11,000 Mahamrityunjaya jaap rituals and special festival Yagyas.

priests.name: Pt. Shivkumar Tripathi Jyotishacharya
priests.title: Katha Acharya & Ritual Priest
priests.specialization: Satyanarayan Vrat Katha, Navgrah Shanti, Janeu Sanskar
priests.bio: Renowned for devout recitals of Satyanarayan Swami Katha and guiding pilgrims in traditional Sanskar rituals.

priests.name: Pt. Harivansh Mishra Shastri
priests.title: Aarti & Annakshetra Priest
priests.specialization: Evening Ganga Aarti, Annakshetra Bhog, Mangal Aarti
priests.bio: Leads the daily Mangal Aarti and supervises holy prasadam preparations at temple Annakshetra.
